activity.notes: The Federal Assembly again appointed Dufour commander-in-chief in August 1849 during the Baden Revolution to protect Swiss territory. ATLAS records this as a distinct temporary generalship.

sources.title: Guillaume Henri Dufour (1787–1875) — Swiss Armed Forces
sources.citation_text: The Swiss Armed Forces records Dufour's second appointment as commander-in-chief in August 1849 during the Baden Revolution.
